subject: VPC/on-prem account activation — readiness ingredients & owner checklist
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@piedmonthealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: network-ops@piedmonthealth.com
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial intake — Piedmont VPC/on-prem activation

Hi Karthik / Ben,

Thanks for taking this on. We're kicking off our private deployment intake for Piedmont's research cluster and wanted to share our environment baseline and ask for a concise owner-side checklist so our infra team can prepare. Attached is a simple network diagram and a spreadsheet with current service accounts (initial-network-diagram.png, activation-templates.xlsx).

High‑level requirements:
- VPC peering + dedicated egress NAT (US‑East)
- KMS integration for model keys (customer‑managed)
- Tenant service account with scoped IAM roles and audit logging

Questions we need answered up front:
1) Which CIDR blocks should we reserve for the tenant (prefer minimal overlap)?
2) Any required network ACLs or port allowlists beyond HTTPS (443) and internal health probes?
3) Expected lead time for private control plane service account provisioning?

Can you confirm the activation owner and provide a small checklist we can run against our staging VPC this week? We're aiming for an initial smoke test 2026-08-20 during our 02:00–04:00 maintenance window.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Director, Cloud Services
Piedmont Health

Attachments:
- initial-network-diagram.png (diagram/png)
- activation-templates.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@piedmonthealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial intake — Piedmont VPC/on-prem activation

Alice — thanks for the diagram and the template. I'm the activation owner for this engagement; Ben will lead networking, Marissa will own ops/rollout, and Jasmine will handle the KMS keys & compliance handoff. Below is a compact "ingredients" checklist you can run through with your infra team before we schedule a handoff call.

Activation readiness ingredients (quick checklist):
1) Network CIDR suggestion: please reserve a /20 (10.40.0.0/20) for tenant subnets to avoid overlap; if you have an existing range preference, share and we'll validate.
2) BGP/peering prep: confirm ASN and upstream peer IPs; provide region egress endpoint (we recommend us-east-1).
3) IP allowlist: list of static egress IPs we'll provide for webhook callbacks + health probes.
4) Firewall ports: allow 443 outbound; allow inbound from our monitoring probes on 9000/TCP if you plan internal health checks; management SSH only via jump host (22 restricted to specified admin IPs).
5) Service accounts: a tenant SvcAcct with roles: viewer, storage.objectViewer, kmsCryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter; share service account email and we will grant additional roles as needed.
6) KMS/HSM: provide KMS key ARN or let us provision a key policy stub; for HSM, we need contact for procurement and key rotation windows.
7) Audit log sink: enable admin & data plane audit logs and give read access to redwood-ops@piedmonthealth.com (we will provide a principal).
8) Maintenance window: confirm the 2026-08-20 02:00–04:00 window for smoke tests.

Next steps:
- Ben and I will run a short preflight call (30m) to validate firewall rules and BGP details.
- I'll upload a short activation playbook (tenant-service-account-guide.pdf) to the Drive link and add a lightweight runbook for your ops team.

Attached: activation-templates.xlsx (updated with suggested role bindings).

Would you like Ben to join the call tomorrow 08/16 at 10:00am ET or would later that day work?

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Technical Program Manager — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- activation-templates.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx, updated)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@piedmonthealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-16T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial intake — Piedmont VPC/on-prem activation

Quick network notes from Ben (copying the team).

Alice — a couple clarifications before the preflight:
- CIDR: /20 works fine; if Piedmont already uses 10.40.0.0/16 anywhere, please pick a disjoint /20 and send the pref. We will validate for NAT overlap.
- Egress IPs: we usually provide a pool of 4 static egress IPs for callbacks; firewall rules should allow outbound to those IPs on 443 and outbound to our telemetry endpoint on 443.
- Health probes: our runtime needs to reach port 9000/TCP for readiness checks in some configs. If that is a blocker, confirm and we'll adjust the probe strategy to use HTTPS endpoints instead.
- Peering latency: if your onprem has an MPLS link, share the expected p95 latency; for low‑latency inference we recommend <30ms between model runtime and client.

Proposed preflight agenda (30m):
1) Confirm CIDR + ASN (5m)
2) Exchange egress IPs & firewall entries (10m)
3) KMS access model decision + service account binding (10m)
4) Smoke test plan + schedule (5m)

I can do 08/16 at 13:00 ET — Karthik, confirm if that works for you & Alice.

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

Quick answers inline:

- Ports: we'll enable 443 outbound; 9000/TCP will be allowed for the staging ring only — production will be HTTPS probes.
- Service account: service-account-piedmont@piedmonthealth.iam.gserviceaccount.com — we'll grant viewer/storage.objectViewer to start.

We'll be ready for a short smoke test 2026-08-20 02:00–03:00 ET (we can shorten to 1 hour). Please send the preflight agenda and a short runbook link; I'll circulate internally.
